source_caption_text:
Lil Uzi Vert and MGK really didn’t care about getting kicked out for sm*king at the 2017 Billboard Awards 😂😭

Throwback to Lil Uzi Vert and Machine Gun Kelly casually sm*king together in the middle of the Billboard Music Awards in 2017. While everyone around them was dressed up for one of the biggest nights in music, the two artists were completely in their own world.

The moment quickly stood out because of how casually they were doing it right in the middle of the audience. People sitting nearby could only look over in disbelief as Uzi and MGK continued enjoying themselves like they were anywhere but an awards show.

Years later, the clip still gets shared as one of those unforgettable moments from the era. Uzi and MGK brought their rebellious rockstar energy to the Billboard Music Awards and somehow made the formal event feel a lot less formal.

#liluzivert #mgk #rap
